title: How to join a tournament
english: Players join a tournament by reacting with the white check mark emoji on the tournament announcement. Sign-ups close automatically when an admin starts the tournament.

title: Brackets
english: When an admin starts the tournament, players are shuffled randomly and paired into Round 1 matches. If the number of players is odd, one player gets a bye and advances automatically.

title: What can Tony Stark do?
english: Tony Stark can chat, remember your conversation, look up facts on Wikipedia, and run gaming tournaments with automatic brackets. He understands English, Hinglish, and Khasi.

title: Who can create tournaments?
english: Only server admins and moderators can create, start, or cancel tournaments. Regular members can join and view.
